title: Provider-neutral Customer Evidence Pack Pilot

notes: Assessment-specific evidence thresholds, gate requirements and synthetic claims are internal pilot assumptions, not external normative requirements.

required_requests.reason: Contracting entity and effective-control scope must be evidenced for a high-criticality cloud workload.
Legal/extraterritorial exposure is treated as a high-confidence review topic in this synthetic case.
Applied data-location configuration is required; provider capability alone is insufficient.
Key-control evaluation requires evidence of the applied key-management configuration.
Exit requires documented usable export of data, metadata, configuration and policy.
High-criticality exit confidence requires an end-to-end test in this pilot.
Operational autonomy is in scope and requires a tested degraded-mode/continuity assumption.
Identity and trust anchors must be evidenced at applied configuration level.
Critical workload dependencies and subproviders must at least be documented.
Security-minimum evaluation requires evidence that controls are actually configured.
For this high-criticality pilot, security effectiveness needs tested or attested evidence.

not_required_requests.reason: Portfolio concentration is outside this single-workload pilot.
No AI workload in this pilot.
No agentic AI in this pilot.
